negative_results: No global TimeSeries samples.value codec promotion: compressed size winner flips by Float64 entropy, and CPU benefits vary by selector/time layout/concurrency; stock O1 binary cannot prove production behavior.

Start-alignment R18 has a synthetic time-shift anomaly at boundaries: not a physical continuous 400-active-node simulator; don't attribute CPU +62% solely to array decode, index marks or codec; full native time-series output between different timestamps intentionally differs.

Earlier two-variable R18 ALP+ZSTD3 vs ZSTD1 namespace CPU+10% is not repeated in pure ALP factor: new fixed-ZSTD3 patterned namespace CPU ~0%. Invalid pilot evidence and control drift must remain visible.

Jemalloc binary includes 2 nonallocator C++ patches. Even with inactive narrow sum(rate()) and default JOIN semantics on R18 avg queries, stock-O1(glibc) vs patched-O1(jemalloc) cannot isolate allocator cost; need exactly matched source+compiler with only allocator variant.
Jemalloc operational CI #41637869309 pending; no performance/correctness conclusion before completion, and don't cancel any other agent's workflow.

Single unpaired bulk writes/merges in R18 are not a steady-state write/merge proof. R02 owns natural writer throughput work, R07 owns SQL rewrite, R10 buckets, R14 grid, R19 metadata/TTL; avoid duplicate ownership.
blocked_by: R18 patched jemalloc 4992 native query operational CI #41637869309 running and needs evidence artifact/oracle/physical/controls/OOM checks before promotion. No background agent guarantee; future agents must inspect and record results.
No matched glibc allocator build with exactly the same two C++ patches and compiler flags, so causal jemalloc vs glibc CPU/memory comparison is not yet established.
